title: Mallard Sample Numbering Correction
notes: Corrected Mallard sample numbering so the 1000 series is Oilfield and the 2000 series is Non Oilfield.
Corrected existing sample 1001 to Oilfield and reserved physical sample 2001 for Non Oilfield.
Future automatic numbering now continues at 1002 for Oilfield, 2002 for Non Oilfield and 3001 for Odd / Weird.
Added range validation so manually supplied sample numbers cannot be assigned to the wrong category.
